programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Big Day for Baby Rhino
programs.desc: Terri helps prepare the zoo's new baby rhino, Carrie, to receive a lifesaving vaccine  Robert is on a rescue mission to save two black swans in very bad shape  Bindi tries to determine if a cranky wombat named Poa might be pregnant.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Top Cats
programs.desc: Tom is called out to Olympia on a late night rescue mission  neighborhood dog chases large indoor cat, Earl, high up on a tree and doesn't exactly let Tom rescue him  Play-Play needs rescuing in La Conner.

programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.: At All Costs
programs.desc: Ivan goes on a journey to save his friend's 19 rhinos from the poaching epidemic now sweeping through South Africa. The solution: a logistical nightmare of transporting the entire herd to a secure location 600 miles across the country.

programs.title: Great White Shark Babies
programs.desc: Dr. Mauricio Hoyos teams up with Michelle Jewell and Toby Daly-Engel in search of where the pregnant females of Guadalupe have their pups. Mauricio believes they go to the coast of Baja, but what they find while they're there is a Shark Week first.

programs.title: The Zoo: Fawns Become Friends
programs.desc: Two sickly newborn fawns form an unbreakable bond while they are hand-reared by staff  the leopard Khazo gets a surprise that enhances its life, and tensions run high as the reptile staff attempts to collect blood from Cuban crocs.

programs.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Running Free
programs.desc: Follow stray pups in Thailand through the first weeks of their dangerous lives. And in Kathmandu, dogs are worshiped and dressed with garlands for the Tihar festival.
